section_summary.extract_value: This introduction reviews the development and validation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its refinement, the BAS-2, across many countries and sample types. It highlights evidence for one-dimensional BAS-2 structure in many validations, discusses mixed findings regarding sex invariance and sex differences, and notes inconsistent associations between BAS-2 scores and BMI across studies. No original study methods, sample sizes, or single-study statistics are reported in this section.
